identityContract.speciesConcept: Original friendly desk-hog virtual pet; generic hedgehog anatomy only.
identityContract.viewpoint: Full-body front three-quarter view facing screen-right.
sharedMarks: cream forehead notch above the visible eye
identityContract.child: Rounder head and torso, shortest limbs, compact quill mass.
identityContract.adult: Same individual with taller torso, longer limbs and snout, and a more developed quill mass; not a uniform scale-up.

nonRuntimeNote: These are canonical non-runtime reference masters. They must not be placed under raw-png/ and must not be consumed by png2c.py.

acceptance.reviewer: Project owner authorized source-only cleanup; Codex performed implementation self-review.
acceptance.notes: Both masters are RGBA with binary alpha, transparent corners, no floor/shadow/scenery/text, and a ten-color-or-fewer visible palette. Child/adult nearest-neighbor previews retain the shared palette, screen-right composition, visual center, and y=28 ground line. The adult is visibly larger and more developed while retaining the child identity.
